title: Oven Roasted Chinese Chicken Noodles
description: A resinous and shattering Chinese dish featuring candied peel and katsuramuki-cut noodles, perfect for a brunch mood, and diabetic-friendly due to its balanced ingredients and portion control.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Spread the chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, cook the katsuramuki-cut noodles according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together candied peel, scallions, and ginger.
After the chicken has roasted for 20 minutes, add the cooked noodles and candied peel mixture to the baking sheet and toss to combine.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
